notes:
**Per-shot overlay lifecycle guardrails**

- **`review_by`** — log warning when a per-shot overlay should be re-checked (stale `disable_checks`)
- **`expires`** — expired overlays are ignored; base ruleset runs instead of masking regressions
- **`created` / `max_age_days`** — age warnings when shot overlay JSON has not been reviewed (default 90 days)
- New tests in `tests/test_per_shot_rules.py`
